sentences.text: Researchers conducted a retrospective analysis of patient records from a university hospital in Germany, focusing on individuals who underwent head and neck tumor surgery with immediate reconstruction between 2021 and 2024.
Statistical models were applied to determine whether preoperative use of benzodiazepine receptor agonists or antidepressants was linked to the development of postoperative delirium.

While being 70 years old or older was the only factor significantly associated with a higher risk of delirium, preoperative benzodiazepine receptor agonist use was not significantly associated with its occurrence.
Although a simple analysis suggested a link between antidepressant use and delirium, this association was not confirmed when other factors were taken into account.
The authors note that existing research on this topic is inconsistent and the overall level of evidence is low.
